feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 June 2026 11:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 07 June 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of the British Isles, with an associated front crossing our area overnight.


##Wind##

Southwest or south-southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 this afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 late evening or early tonight, then veering west or northwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate building moderate or rough this afternoon. Falling slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Rain arriving from the west this afternoon, turning heavy at times. Becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor at times in the rain, becoming good overnight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, backing southwest Monday afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 Monday evening, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate building mostly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, showers developing later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers later.
